params.prompt: Start from the exact composition of the start image (microneedling). Continue the facial treatment calmly with subtle hand movements. The start and end images are mandatory visual targets: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret their compositions; animate the existing scenes preserving their visual identity. Photorealistic premium clinical cinematography, natural human movement, anatomically correct hands, fingers, teeth and faces. Preserve patient identity, instruments, devices and environments. Smooth restrained camera movement, subtle focus changes, consistent lighting, realistic skin and dental textures.
